mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines over the prior 30 days, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 0.5% in the prior month, it signals monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in nonfarm payrolls signals strong labor market conditions that boost corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE falls and PAYEMS rises, or Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.05 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, a decline in housing starts relative to the prior year signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of late-cycle expansion periods with declining HOUST, or Rank IC for the signal in late-cycle is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production over the prior month indicates robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO increases over the prior 30 days, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 5-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.5% in the prior month, it signals labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE > 4.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in consumer spending (RSAFS) and rise in inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals stagflationary pressures that depress equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where RSAFS falls and CPIAUCSL rises, or Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.05 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation (CPIAUCSL y/y > 3.0%), a rise in the federal funds rate signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases real interest rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where CPIAUCSL y/y > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS rises, or Rank IC for the signal in high inflation periods is below 0.05.
